text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder was able to achieve
splendid results in the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those
truly precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We've reached a major milestone
together, haven't we~?
choice_data_list: I'm so glad we finished without any issues...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my... Trainer,
are you tearing up again by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Have you been a little crybaby ever since the Arima Kinen~? There, there♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...And with that said, once you've properly dried your eyes, there is something I would like you to see.
choice_data_list: Is there something you'd like me to see?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. See, back at the very beginning,
I showed you the written oath, did I not?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So this time, as a grand finale—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I shall dedicate one of my favorite songs
to you, Trainer.
And so, once again, I receive a sheet of calligraphy paper from Grass Wonder.

Unfolding it, written there in a soft, gentle hand
that brought a certain warmth to the heart――

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"‘If every year the spring arrives,
thus let us crown our heads with plum blossoms
and merrily drink.’"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—I will brew some delicious tea for us.
Let us celebrate spring together every year~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And then, after that...
please walk with me again.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Because our path
still stretches far ahead!
